Theme

look over verb

also go round, look over a book, read through

classical

lūstrō, lūstrāre

verb, first conjugation

go round and look things over

Other words

  • contemplor, contemplārī, contemplātus sum — look over attentively, survey (a person, a thing)

    verb, first conjugation, deponent · also used · classical · Lewis & Short; Traupman 341: contemplāre

    Classical prose has the deponent contemplor; the active contemplō that Traupman prints is ante- and post-classical (Lewis & Short).

  • perlegō, perlegere, perlēgī, perlēctum — read through, look over (a book, an essay)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 341

SourcesLewis & Short: lustro · Lewis & Short: contemplor · Lewis & Short: perlego

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 341.
